author: bleenko
text_post: I aim for this to be a resource for anyone who wants to painlessly and honorably approach a female with the intent of getting to know her, for the end of eventually marrying her. This is not a random hook up guide, nor is this a guide on how to score. This is only for someone looking to fall in love for the long haul. I recommend that you be a Christian, as much of this will make more sense, but this is open to everyone, as the wisdom concerning women applies in general. It is meant to be as concise as possible, with the aim of being a collection of reminders and mental tools to rely on when pursuing a female. First, consider the female you are attracted to. That moment when you see her and your emotions are stirred. Let us stop there and begin to ask a series of questions first. Would you carry on a long term relationship with this girl if she were to respond positively to you? We have to consider her feelings. We're not just going to use someone for sex and intimacy. Is she too attractive?  Look at it this way, while you may have the chance of being with her, it would be better for her and easier for her to be with a man on her level of attractiveness. If you were to have her, it might be more effort than you are prepared to endure in order to keep her. Is she too young? Don't be afraid to ask a girl how old she is. Put these thoughts into your head: "This girl looks attractive. But she looks young. I would be happy to date her, but I don't know if she's too young. I should ask her, she won't mind. I'm simply asking her age, because everyone wants to be happy, and it's not bad to want to date someone you immediately experience attraction towards. I can ask her for her age. It's okay. Then I'll thank her, and if she's too young, I'll carry on what I'm doing so as to not make her feel uncomfortable." Is she too old? While a long term relationship with an older woman is possible, consider yourself and make sure you wouldn't end it after you had had sex with her a number of times. Does she have kids? If you are prepared to enter into a relationship with a woman who has children, go ahead. Just consider that you will have to take on the role of father, and that much time will be spent taking care of them and helping raise them. Sex will probably be infrequent, but will be definite. You will basically be advancing to the state of post-married life with children. A decent and honorable stage to enter that will put you ahead of most people, but will require you to endure boot-camp like training to maintain it. A woman with kids will be slightly more open to a relationship. Use this to fuel your confidence slightly. Does she dress in a way that clearly indicates her personality? Can you deal with that personality? Would you be willing to adapt to that personality? What would it require to maintain a relationship with that type of female? Miscellaneous considerations: Either they are attractive and stir the longing of your heart and desires, or they do not. So I have not commented on weight and other bodily features. I have offered what I consider when evaluating a potential girlfriend. Now, you have decided to go for it.  The lines I use, which you are free to use or modify, are: "Would you like to go out with me some time?" "Hey. Maybe I could get your number. I'd like to call you and talk to you, get to know you some time." Approach them naturally. Not too slow, not too fast. Try to do it not from far away, so there isn't this awkward oncoming. You want to appear in their space naturally giving them about 2 or 3 seconds to be aware of your presence and the fact that you are approaching them. Smile or don't. Be natural. If you are scared, swallow it up.  The goal is this: To be face to face with the female. To present the line without stammering, in a friendly tone, without regard for its success, but in hope. Present it clearly, not too loud, not too soft, making eye contact if possible, looking to the side to avoid awkwardness, but always being direct and maintaining your control of the moment. After you have delivered the line, catch yourself and pause for her response. If she gives a polite "no", or some form of it, listen to every word, maintain your composure, and prepare to say, "That's okay, thanks!", and find a natural way to exit the scene. If she does not give a polite no, but offers an excuse, simply accept it and refer to what I just said about gracefully ending the encounter. If you run into her again, make brief eye contact, smile a little bit, and give a friendly nod or polite wave, and then look away and look as if you are carrying on about your business. If she says yes (this is what this is all about, allow me to throw in a THANK YOU LORD, and allow for fireworks in your stomach), then don't smile too big, but appear pleased and happy that she responded positively. You should have a piece of paper and a pen ready. Don't worry, it won't seem out of the ordinary, if she's accepting you, it will make it easier for you to be prepared to copy down her number. Perhaps offer a couple of things to fill out the encounter (friendly banter), and remind her that you will contact her later. Find a way to exit the scene so that you don't encounter her again. This is so that she can let the encounter settle in her mind, and so that you can accept what has just happened without being too eager. So there you have it. How to approach a girl in confidence, how to deliver the question and ask her out, how to deal with acceptance or rejection, and how to gracefully end the encounter. I hope this helps some of you. Comments and criticisms are welcome, and I will make modifications as time goes on, since I want this to be a commonly referred to resource.
